description: Our award winning bike for 'bike share' schemes and commercial fleet use.

components.description: Twist bell complete with security bolt.
Shimano Nexus roller brakes front and rear.
Alloy crankset, 3/32x38T, 170mm with security steel crank bolt.
Ultra-tough plastic mudguards with rear advertising panels and integrated rear reflector.
Single crown corrosion resistant aluminium alloy fork.
Lock-on comfort rubber grips with security bolts.
70mm rise oversize alloy bar with plastic blend anti-vandal guard.
Shimano Nexus 3-speed with dynamo front hub and Revoshift gear change unit.
Heavy duty die-cast aluminium alloy stand with push spring movement.
Dynamo powered bicycle lighting system:Front: white LED light integrated into locking system.Rear: red LED mudguard integrated light.
Patented mounted wheel locking system that can be activated when docked or undocked.
Full ball bearing anti-slip plastic pedals.
Front alloy carrier with elastic securing cord plus front advertising plate and reflector (max 10kg payload).
High-comfort saddle with gel pads on alloy seat post with engraved height increments (includes anti-theft security kit).
24" 1.75" Schwalbe marathon plus tyres with extra SmartGuard puncture protection and reflective side walls.
Patented quick-release twin cam alloy seat tube clamp.
24" heavy-duty alloy rim with double wall 'bell' ferrule.
